answer: The independent practitioner provided limited assurance over the 2025 Sustainability Information marked with Δ on report pages 12, 18, 22, 25, 27, 30, 32, 33, 35, 36 and 39. Nothing came to attention indicating that it was not prepared, in all material respects, under the Reporting Criteria. The engagement followed ISAE 3000 (Revised) and, for GHG statements, ISAE 3410. It excludes earlier periods, other report/Annual Report/Form 20-F/website information and media; expresses no conclusion that 124,300 tonnes of carbon-removal credits caused or will cause that reduction; and provides no assurance on forward-looking assumptions or achievability. Limited-assurance procedures are less extensive than reasonable assurance and therefore provide substantially lower assurance.

normalized_value.conclusion: nothing has come to our attention that causes us to believe the Sustainability Information is not prepared, in all material respects, in accordance with the Reporting Criteria
normalized_value.standards: ISAE 3000 (Revised) and ISAE 3410 for greenhouse gas emissions
normalized_value.earlier_and_other_information_exclusion: earlier periods and other information in the Report, Annual Report, Form 20-F or website, including images, audio and embedded videos
normalized_value.carbon_credit_conclusion_exclusion: no conclusion whether carbon removal credits resulted or will result in a reduction of 124,300 tonnes CO2e
normalized_value.forward_looking_exclusion: no assurance on assumptions and achievability of forward-looking information
normalized_value.relative_assurance: procedures are less extensive than reasonable assurance and the assurance level is substantially lower
